HP-TES Modifications The modified heat pump (HP) prototype was derived from a commercially available 4-ton (14.1 kW) rooftop packaged unit to enable six operating modes that integrate a hydronic thermal energy storage (TES) loop. The primary design modifications required to support this multi-functional operation include hardware additions, refrigerant circuit reconfiguration, and advanced control implementation. Key modifications and components are listed as follows. • Dual reversing-valve configuration: ORNL developed a two-reversing-valve arrangement to enable smooth switching among normal, TES charge, and TES discharge modes in both heating and cooling seasons.
